text: Rotating a signing secret keeps the old secret valid for 24 hours, so during rotation accept a signature that matches either secret.
Our pricing page lists three plans. The Team plan includes up to ten seats and priority email support.
The dashboard supports dark mode. Toggle it from your profile menu.
You can export invoices as CSV from the Billing tab. Exports include line items and tax totals.
Each endpoint has its own signing secret; rotating it from the endpoint settings page issues a new one immediately.
Team members can be invited from Settings, then Members. Invitations expire after seven days.
